Reserve Your Seat See what happens

Every heart is sacred.
So is the one beside you.

Most couples never get a weekend set apart just for the two of them, free from the noise of daily life. This is that weekend.

You’ll look honestly at where you’ve been, where you are, and where you want to go together, and leave with real tools you can use the next morning.

We work hard, and we play hard… lots of fun!

Reserve Your Seat

What you’ll experience

Three things couples tell us they didn’t know they were missing.

Reconnect

Slow down, look at each other, and remember why you chose each other.

Heal

You can’t change or heal what you don’t acknowledge. A safe place to do both, together.

Move forward

Leave with a shared vision and practical tools for the road ahead.

“Live life Alive! Everyone deserves Freedom and Peace.”

The weekend

Friday evening through Sunday afternoon, in a comfortable hotel just north of DFW Airport. Everything is taken care of, so you can focus on each other.

What’s included

  • Two nights in the hotel (Friday and Saturday), a room for the two of you
  • Friday night hors d’oeuvres before we begin at 7:00 pm
  • Saturday night hors d’oeuvres, dinner and dance
  • Snacks, coffee, tea and water throughout the weekend
  • All training sessions and materials

Where we’ll be

Four Points by Sheraton Dallas Fort Worth Airport North Hotel & Convention Center
Coppell, Texas, about six miles from DFW Airport

  • Begins Friday at 7:00 pm; ends Sunday at 3:00 pm
  • Modern rooms with free Wi-Fi, an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness center, and an on-site restaurant and bar
  • Free parking for guests
  • Flying into DFW? The hotel’s free shuttle runs every hour, around the clock. Love Field? You’ll need an Uber or taxi.
